    <p>Kolkata is often called the Biryani Capital of Eastern India, known for its subtle spices, fragrant long-grain rice, tender meat, and the iconic potato that defines its unique biryani style. Among the many legendary names that have shaped this culinary identity, Aminia stands as one of the oldest and most respected Mughlai restaurants in the city. Alongside iconic names like Arsalan, Shiraz, and Royal Indian Hotel, Aminia has built a reputation that spans generations.</p><p>For decades, Aminia has been synonymous with authentic Mughlai flavors, rich gravies, and consistently satisfying biryani. With multiple outlets across Kolkata, it continues to attract families, tourists, and loyal food lovers.
